resources.title: 10 Hidden AI Mistakes Nobody Warns You About (2026)
resources.description: A free 15-page Digital Pathshala e-book exploring ten overlooked AI behaviours. Try a two-minute experiment for each, use ten ready-to-copy correction prompts, and practise with the one-page Fix Kit and seven-day challenge.
highlights: 10 lesser-known AI mistakes explained in plain language
A two-minute experiment for every chapter
